title: Day one through day 90 and worker transitions

scenes.title: Day one through day 90 and worker transitions
scenes.text: Business Case 12 begins when the worker starts or an effective relationship change is proposed. Milestones and transition effects remain effective-dated, reversible and reconciled. The governed record is TRN-DEMO-001. The accountable actors are Employee, Manager, Buddy, People Operations, HRIS, IT, Facilities. This demonstration uses synthetic browser-memory data and creates no database, provider, message or external-system effect.

scenes.title: 5 accountable processes
scenes.text: The action-level data-flow diagram defines 5 processes before product navigation. Every process identifies the actor, screen, action, input, output, business object, event, governed store, rule, denial and recovery. The highlighted path keeps each business grain and version distinct.

scenes.title: Actor, action, evidence and downstream state
scenes.text: Process 1, Employee: Complete day-one and 30/60/90 milestones. The action record progress and support needs produces milestone evidence in the Journey ledger. Process 2, People Operations: Propose effective-dated transition. The action select transition and reason produces transition draft in the Lifecycle ledger. Process 3, Approvers: Preview impact and approve. The action compare before and after produces approved execution plan in the Lifecycle ledger. Process 4, System Owners: Execute or compensate. The action create downstream work produces per-destination effects and receipts in the Effect ledger. Process 5, People Operations: Reconcile final state. The action compare expected and observed produces closed, blocked or restated outcome in the Analytics store.

scenes.title: Open TRN-DEMO-001 in context
scenes.text: The actual product route is /hr/transitions/TRN-DEMO-001/impact. It presents worker-transition execution and compensating-work graph in the surrounding recruitment or onboarding workspace. The screen remains a wireframe, but its identifiers, current state, navigation, data relationships and action boundaries match the business contract used by the connected workbench.

scenes.title: Inspect fields, scope and business grains
scenes.text: The seeded workbench follows record TRN-DEMO-001. Its governed fields are Transition, Crossboard to Product Design; Effective date, December 1, 2026; Before, Recruiting Ops , SF; After, Product Design , Remote CA; Downstream effects, HRIS, IGA, benefits, facilities; Partial state, HRIS success , 3 effects pending. Field classifications remain visible so the presenter can distinguish public, internal, confidential and restricted projections for the active persona.

scenes.title: Approve and execute transition
scenes.text: With People Operations selected, we perform approve and execute transition. The guard requires impact owners, approvals, effective date and safe execution order pass. The state changes from Impact preview to Reconciled with compensation, records WorkerTransitionReconciled, writes to the Lifecycle effect ledger, and creates the handoff: HRIS, IT, facilities and benefits owners receive ordered work.

scenes.title: Simulate partial downstream success
scenes.text: We now exercise the controlled exception: Simulate partial downstream success. The prepared failure is HRIS succeeded but access and benefits failed. Unsupported downstream work stops, successful prior evidence remains intact, and the state-change receipt assigns explicit recovery without hiding the failed attempt.

scenes.title: Run compensating work
scenes.text: The owned recovery is Run compensating work. It reuses the governed business context without duplicating completed effects. The new receipt preserves previous state, current state, actor, event and correlation key. The control center and handoff inbox then expose the same recovery through transition completion, partial failures and compensation age and minimum-context next-actor work.

scenes.title: Milestones and transition effects remain effective-dated, reversible and reconciled.
scenes.text: Business Case 12 is complete. We demonstrated the level-two process contract, the actual product route, governed field projections, the primary state transition, a controlled exception, targeted recovery, causal dashboard evidence and the next-actor handoff. Milestones and transition effects remain effective-dated, reversible and reconciled. Production identity, persistence, integrations and external delivery remain separate implementation gates.
